summary: The FDA label warns to keep Ascorbic Acid out of reach of children, as with all medications [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, this drug received a low score of 29 for liver risk and a low score of 10 for heart risk [M]. Additionally, several clinical trials studying this drug were stopped early due to issues such as enrollment difficulties or too few outcome events [5][6][7].
